record.context_brief: Parity of West t-stack sortable permutations
record.original_question: For a permutation pi, let s(pi) be the output of the greedy stack-sorting algorithm, and call pi West t-stack sortable if s^t(pi) is the identity permutation. For which pairs (t, n) is the number of West t-stack sortable permutations of length n odd?

evidence.quote: A permutation is West t-stack sortable if st(π) is the identity permutation.
Problem (Miklós Bóna): For which t, n is the number of West t-stack sortable permutations of length n an odd number?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S_n$ denote the symmetric group on $\{1,2,\dots,n\}$. Define the greedy (West) stack-sorting operator $s : S_n \to S_n$ as follows. Given a permutation $\pi = \pi_1\pi_2\cdots\pi_n$, process its entries from left to right using a single stack. At each step, if the stack is empty or the next input entry is smaller than the current top of the stack, push the next input entry onto the stack; otherwise, pop the top of the stack and append it to the output. When the input is exhausted, pop the remaining stack entries onto the output in order. The resulting output sequence is $s(\pi)$.

For a positive integer $t$, call a permutation $\pi \in S_n$ West $t$-stack sortable if $s^t(\pi) = \mathrm{id}$, where $s^t$ denotes the $t$-fold iteration of $s$ and $\mathrm{id}$ is the identity permutation. Let $W_t(n)$ denote the number of West $t$-stack sortable permutations of length $n$.

Determine all pairs of positive integers $(t,n)$ for which $W_t(n)$ is odd.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is a question of Bóna asking to characterize the parities of the counts $W_t(n)$. Recent work has examined the parity of $W_3(n)$ and used it as evidence against a related conjecture of Bóna, but no general characterization of which $(t,n)$ give odd $W_t(n)$ appears to have been established. The problem appears to remain open in its general form.

status_evidence.title: Parity statistics on restricted permutations and the Catalan–Schett polynomials
status_evidence.snippet: Examining the parities of the numbers W_3(n), researchers obtained strong evidence against another conjecture of Bóna.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work studies parities of W_t(n) but does not give a full characterization of (t,n) with W_t(n) odd.

status_evidence.title: A Survey of Stack Sortable Permutations
status_evidence.snippet: Survey by Bóna of stack-sortable permutations including open problems.
status_evidence.claim: General parity characterization of W_t(n) is not reported as resolved in surveys.
